title: Static GK: Black Sea Geographical Straits & Bordering Nations
summary: Marginal sea connecting Europe and Asia via Bosphorus, Dardanelles, and Kerch Straits.

blocks.content: Marginal sea connecting Europe and Asia via Bosphorus, Dardanelles, and Kerch Straits.

items: Bordering Nations (6 Countries): Bulgaria, Romania, Ukraine, Russia, Georgia, and Türkiye.
Connecting Waterways: Linked to Sea of Marmara via Bosphorus Strait; to Aegean Sea via Dardanelles Strait; to Sea of Azov via Kerch Strait.
